claims.statement: Pilot definition: a break object requires scope, direction, broken_object_id, broken_price, confirmation_candle_id, and a body close beyond the broken wick extreme. Wick-only contact creates a probe/sweep candidate.

Pilot definition: external CHoCH is the first opposing body-close break of the current parent protected point. An opposing internal break remains recovery/pullback evidence unless the parent point is broken.
Pilot definition: BOS is a same-direction continuation break after structural direction is established; if prior direction is unresolved, classify the break event without forcing BOS versus CHoCH.

Pilot split: body-close geometry determines break existence; displacement is recorded separately as quality. Trade/action promotion may require displacement, but perception must not erase a geometric break solely for weak impulse until adjudicated evidence resolves the conflict.
Pilot definition: OB, FVG, breaker, and generic supply/demand remain different object kinds with separate origin evidence and lifecycle. Overlap may create confluence but not identity.
Pilot abstention: missing parent direction, unconfirmed protected point, insufficient left context, contradictory parent/child evidence, or ungrounded POI requires UNCLEAR or REVIEW_REQUIRED.

unresolved_conflicts: Displacement threshold and whether it changes object existence.
Objective rule for selecting among multiple origin candles or candle clusters.
recommendations: Model event existence and event quality as separate fields.
Require causal links from protected point to qualified break.
Do not give pilot definitions runtime authority before blind evaluation.
